note: Jasper County IL publishes no zoning district service. Only Newton's zoning districts exist, as static PDF maps (2021, 2023, 2025) on jaspercountyillinois.gov. The county's Survey123 'Jasper County Zoning Map Survey_form' on ArcGIS Online is a point survey, not polygons. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer found for the county or Newton; the county GIS parcel viewer (jasper-il.bhamaps.com) exposes no zoning service found.
